stages.title: RFI/RFQ governance
stages.oneLiner: Reverse-engineer the existing Copilot Studio + LangGraph build and govern it.
stages.agentDoes: Maps decision points; encodes authority bands (€100k, one geo, one line) as a Decision Contract.
stages.gatedAction: Every commit gated; every decision Crypto Passport-signed.
stages.kpis: 0% to 100% of commits within authority bands; audit-ready within the week.

stages.title: Candidate screening
stages.oneLiner: Rank-and-recommend on SuccessFactors; a human signs every decision.
stages.agentDoes: Scores against role criteria; per-candidate reasoning artefact; disparate-impact telemetry.
stages.gatedAction: Article 14 human sign-off enforced at the gateway; never rejects alone.
stages.conditionNote: Works-council approval (27 Jul) and sponsor appetite for a high-risk first case.

stages.title: SAP wedge (A source-to-PO / B ECR-ECO)
stages.oneLiner: Source-to-PO on SAP MM, or engineering change on SAP PLM.
stages.agentDoes: Ranks suppliers / triages ECRs within policy; drafts PO / decision package.
stages.gatedAction: In-policy commits drawn; out-of-policy escalated; every output signed.
stages.kpis: Routine POs 3-5 days to under 1 hour; ECR triage 2-4 weeks to 24-48 hours.

stages.title: IT-security cloud-evaluation auto-check
stages.oneLiner: Binary control check on the cloud evaluation sheet; approve or hard-reject + escalate.
stages.agentDoes: Applies a clear decision contract to a repetitive, binary check.
stages.gatedAction: Hard-reject and escalate to IT Security when criteria unmet.
stages.kpis: Low blast radius; no works-council exposure.
stages.backupNote: Substitutes for MVP 2 if the sponsor declines candidate screening.

execSummary.t: This Statement of Work covers a
engagement to bring Hensoldt’s agentic AI under enforced authority on the
. It delivers up to three production MVPs on one enforcement layer —
(reverse-engineered from Hensoldt’s existing Copilot Studio + LangGraph build),
(conditional, EU AI Act Annex III), and an

(source-to-PO or engineering change). Every high-stakes decision is Crypto Passport–signed under the NO PASSPORT = NO EXECUTION principle. Work begins on contract signature; production activation follows works-council approval (target 27 July 2026).

objectives: Bring the existing RFI/RFQ agent under explicit authority bands with signed, replayable evidence — defensible at customer and regulator review.
Provide a faster, regulator-defensible candidate-screening shortlist (conditional on works-council approval) to support the ~9,000-hire growth direction.
Automate routine SAP procurement or engineering-change decisions inside policy, freeing senior time for the decisions that matter.
Stand up one reusable enforcement layer — Decision Contracts, Crypto Passport signing, Flight Recorder telemetry — that subsequent agents inherit.
Produce EU AI Act Article 43/47 documentation as a by-product of running on the platform.

scopeIn.description: Reverse-engineer the existing Copilot Studio + LangGraph build into Apollo; map decision points and gaps; author Decision Contract (authority bands €100k, one geography, one line); gateway enforcement; Crypto Passport signing.

Rank-and-recommend agent on SuccessFactors; Article 14 human sign-off enforced at the gateway; disparate-impact telemetry; FRIA workstream; per-candidate reasoning artefact. In scope only on works-council approval.

One of: source-to-PO on SAP MM (sourcing → signed PO inside policy) OR ECR/ECO on SAP PLM (triage → ECCB-approved, with ITAR/AWG export-control screening). Wedge confirmed with the SAP transformation lead.
Security & data classification; credential-vault setup; stakeholder onboarding; platform and read access. Absorbed within MVP 1 effort.
Three-tier AQVP certification of each agent before production.
Signed audit trail per decision; EU AI Act Art 43/47 docs; handover pack.

scopeOut: Data cleansing or ETL beyond agreed integration points.
Ongoing managed service beyond Hypercare (unless separately contracted).
Use cases beyond the named MVPs — including the IT-security cloud-evaluation backup, unless substituted for MVP 2 via change control.
Procurement of third-party licences (SuccessFactors, SAP) — assumed already held by Hensoldt.

sow.timelineIntro: Weeks are relative to formal kickoff; production activation holds until works-council approval. The full week-by-week plan is the accompanying delivery timeline (Appendix A).
assumptions: Hensoldt provides named technical and business leads with decision authority (Alex R confirmed; procurement, HR/Legal, and SAP/engineering SMEs as required).
Hensoldt IT provisions platform and read access (Copilot/LangGraph, SuccessFactors, SAP MM/PLM) within 5 business days of contract signature.
SMEs are available for Discovery workshops during the relevant MVP window.
Named third-party systems (SuccessFactors, SAP) have accessible, documented APIs.
A single Novagentica delivery consultant is assigned; effort is bounded by one person at a maximum of 5 days/week. Any client-side delay extends the timeline by an equivalent period.
riskFlags: Betriebsrat approval is required before any MVP moves to production beyond PoC. Target 27 July 2026. If not resolved, production go-lives slip; build proceeds ahead of the gate under the signed contract.

MVP 2 is conditional on works-council approval and the sponsor accepting a high-risk first case. If declined, the IT-security cloud-evaluation backup (≈ 5 days) substitutes, re-scoped via change control.

MVP 3 wedge (A or B) requires the SAP transformation lead confirmed; his session has slipped two weeks. The framework is identical for A or B, so this is not on the critical path provided confirmation lands by W4.
Route 1 PoC requires the returned IT-security cloud-evaluation sheet (minutes to complete; Alex to provide the template).
sow.cadence: Weekly status (email or short call), Nova Lead to Client Lead; milestone reviews at each MVP go-live and at the 27 July gate; any issue unresolved within 48 hours escalates to the Executive Sponsors.
sow.raciNote: “SME” = the relevant domain expert per MVP (Procurement for MVP 1/3-A; HR + Legal for MVP 2; Engineering / SAP for MVP 3-B). “Sponsor” = Andre.
sow.changeControl: Any change to scope, timeline, or commercials requires a written Change Request signed by both parties. Changes are not in effect until signed. Novagentica will provide an impact assessment within 3 business days of a change request being raised. Because all MVPs share the same enforcement framework, swapping a use case (for example, substituting the IT-security backup for MVP 2) is low-friction and handled through this process.
sow.commercialsNote: Single delivery consultant — days are bounded by one person across the elapsed weeks (max 5 days/week); MVP 1 and MVP 2 are scheduled aggressively at one week each. Foundation, AQVP certification, and engagement management are absorbed within each MVP, not billed separately. Indicative ± ~15%, fixed at sign-off.
